text.tspan: PX4: four execution loops, one sensor-to-estimator map
Single estimator | SENS_IMU_MODE=1 | one SPI IMU + one UART GNSS | source b798249a
FLAT BUILD: one shared address space. The OS / PX4 divider is a responsibility boundary, not memory protection.
PX4 wq:* workers are NOT NuttX HPWORK / LPWORK; no kernel-worker relay is inserted in this IMU path.
TEAL: retained uORB data -> consumer reads. ORANGE DASHED: schedule / wake only, NOT inline Run().
Paired arrows separate data and notification. GREY: device I/O / call-return, not another worker.
A-C each run one wait -> dequeue -> Run() -> repeat loop. D owns its blocking GPS receive loop.
B: VehicleIMU integrates; later EKF2 propagates output and predicts / fuses when ready.
uORB is NOT a thread or broker. Other firmware threads, timers and the work-queue manager are omitted.

g.text: GNSS path: independent arrivals, not a global event order
6 UART RX -> NuttX byte buffer -> read/poll wakes GPS task

text.tspan: read on IMU run; NO wake
